name: io.github.seekdaseek/agentfeed-algo
title: AgentFeed on Algorand
description: Cross-exchange liquidation tape, paid per call in USDC on Algorand. Free catalog, no key needed.

environmentVariables.name: ALGO_PAYER_MNEMONIC
environmentVariables.description: 25 word mnemonic for the Algorand account that pays. Optional: the catalog tool needs no key.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTFEED_ALGO_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the endpoint. Defaults to https://algo.ochinimus.app

environmentVariables.name: ALGO_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: mainnet or testnet. Defaults to mainnet.
